purpose: Define the deterministic statistical scorer interface and diagnostics without changing the frozen first-gate hypothesis, multiplicity, survival criteria, FIFO order, universe, execution semantics, or economic state.

layering.normalized_execution_layer: Produces one canonical candidate row with normalized realized anchored trades. This layer owns raw mask decoding, market-data traversal, Ask/Bid fills, stop/gap/same-day semantics, and trade-by-trade execution parity.
layering.statistical_scorer_layer: Consumes normalized candidate rows and the full frozen eligible DEV trading-date axis. It never decodes event masks, never reconstructs GA1 classes, never reads raw ticks, and never changes trade executions.
layering.reason: The durable GA1 completion proves semantic/alias identity but states mask blobs/index were runtime-local and no portable binary archive was persisted. No durable raw-mask encoding contract was recovered; inventing one is forbidden.
layering.production_gate: Actual economic FIRST_GATE remains forbidden until a normalized execution bundle is accompanied by an independently verified trade-by-trade execution receipt.

normalized_input_contract.candidate_stream_order: arbitrary on input; scorer emits canonical SIGNAL_CONFIG_ID ascending
normalized_input_contract.date_axis: sorted unique YYYY-MM-DD eligible frozen DEV trading dates; no-trade dates remain in axis and contribute zero
normalized_input_contract.R_encoding: finite base-10 string parsed as Decimal; gate comparisons for net_R/expectancy/PF use Decimal without display rounding
normalized_input_contract.candidate_identity: canonical_signal_config_id and event_mask_sha256 must each be unique across the stream
normalized_input_contract.zero_event_rule: zero_event=true requires eligible_event_count=0, event_mask_sha256=SHA256(empty bytes), zero trades, p=1, never survives

primary_test_numeric_contract.daily_R: exact Decimal sum of candidate trade R by trading_date, converted to IEEE-754 binary64 only for HAC moments after aggregation
primary_test_numeric_contract.omega: gamma_0 + 2*sum((1-l/(L+1))*gamma_l for l=1..L), accumulated with math.fsum
primary_test_numeric_contract.degenerate: if trades<30 or SE non-finite or <=0 then raw_p=1; zero-event always raw_p=1

BY_contract.m: all distinct exact mask classes including zero-event

gate_metrics.net_R: exact Decimal sum of trade R
gate_metrics.PF: gross positive R / abs(gross negative R); POS_INF when loss denominator=0 and gross profit>0; null when no positive and no negative R
gate_metrics.win_rate: wins(R>0)/trades; breakeven R=0 is not a win
gate_metrics.survival: BY_rejected AND trades>=30 AND net_R>0 AND expectancy_R>0 AND PF>1

diagnostic_metric_definitions.DD_R: maximum peak-to-trough drawdown of cumulative daily_R across full date_axis, initial equity=0
diagnostic_metric_definitions.recovery: net_R/DD_R when DD_R>0; POS_INF if DD_R=0 and net_R>0; otherwise null
diagnostic_metric_definitions.Sharpe: annualized daily sqrt(252)*mean/sample_std(ddof=1); null if D<2 or denominator<=0/non-finite
diagnostic_metric_definitions.Sortino: annualized daily sqrt(252)*mean/sqrt(mean(min(daily_R,0)^2)); null if downside denominator<=0/non-finite
diagnostic_metric_definitions.year_concentration: max(abs(year_net_R))/sum(abs(year_net_R)); null if denominator=0; full year_net_R map also emitted
diagnostic_metric_definitions.month_concentration: max(abs(month_net_R))/sum(abs(month_net_R)); null if denominator=0; full month_net_R map also emitted
diagnostic_metric_definitions.underwater: emit underwater_days and max_consecutive_underwater_days from daily cumulative equity below prior running peak

diagnostic_governance.reason: The frozen multiplicity contract reports these metrics but does not include them in the candidate survival rule. Definitions are frozen here pre-PnL solely for reproducible reporting.

fail_closed_conditions: PRODUCTION input without independent execution parity receipt
